question: The average weight (in kg) of a family of five members whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 73 kg and 38 kg is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average be 50 kg.

Deviations of the weights from 50 = (40 − 50), (49 − 50), (56 − 50), (73 − 50), and (38 − 50)

Net deviation = −10 − 1 + 6 + 23 − 12 = +6

Average = Assumed average + (Net deviation ÷ 5)

Average = 50 + (6 ÷ 5) = 50 + 1.2 = 51.2 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 51.2 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Weights of 5 family members = 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 73 kg, and 38 kg.

**Formula Used:**

Average
